sources.title: Democratizing access to large-scale language models with OPT-175B
sources.evidence: Dated May 3, 2022. Explicitly announces full release of smaller OPT baselines including the 1.3-billion-parameter model, alongside restricted research access to OPT-175B.

sources.title: OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models
sources.evidence: Table 1 specifies the 1.3B variant with 24 layers, 32 attention heads and width 2048. Section 2 describes decoder-only Transformers, ReLU and 2048-token training sequences. Appendix D confirms that smaller baselines share the noncommercial model license. Reopened October 27, 2026: Table 1 still gives nominal 1.3B; no separate activated-parameter specification is provided.

sources.title: OPT pretrained model weights
sources.evidence: Lists OPT-1.3B with its nominal 1.3B size and direct pretrained-weight download, identifies the OPT family as text-trained NLP models, and links the model-specific license. Reopened October 27, 2026: the official weights table still lists OPT-1.3B as 1.3B parameters.

sources.title: facebook/opt-1.3b exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: OPTForCausalLM; 24 layers, hidden and word embedding width 2048, FFN width 8192, 32 heads, vocabulary 50272, maximum positions 2048, pre-layer normalization and float16. No quantization configuration. Reopened October 27, 2026 at this exact revision; configuration is unchanged.

sources.title: facebook/opt-1.3b PyTorch checkpoint tensor metadata
sources.evidence: Read only bytes 0-131071 via HTTP 206; the complete 49,785-byte data.pkl metadata lists 389 FP16 tensor entries. Token embedding and lm_head share storage 0. Deduplication gives 388 tensors and 1,315,758,080 parameters. All shapes match the configuration and implementation; no buffer, packed or quantization-scale tensors are present.

sources.title: OPT PyTorch reference implementation, Transformers v4.21.0
sources.evidence: Implements dense attention and two dense FFN projections with biases, two affine layer norms per block, a final affine decoder layer norm, a two-row positional offset, and tied bias-free output embeddings. Equal hidden/embedding dimensions omit projection adapters.

sources.title: OPT-175B License Agreement distributed with facebook/opt-1.3b
sources.evidence: Section 1(a) limits the grant to noncommercial research; Section 2 restricts commercial and production use. This custom model license applies to this checkpoint despite its OPT-175B title.

sources.title: facebook/opt-1.3b model card
sources.publisher: Meta AI repository; card text authored by Hugging Face
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint page describes pretrained-only causal language modeling and text generation. It explicitly attributes card prose to Hugging Face; primary training and release claims were cross-checked against Meta sources. No native reasoning mode or structured tool-call interface is specified.

sources.title: facebook/opt-1.3b repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository createdAt is 2022-05-11T08:26:00.000Z, later than the original public release. Lists the publicly accessible PyTorch checkpoint, configuration, tokenizer, license and alternative framework files.

sources.title: OPT baseline training configuration
sources.evidence: Original OPT baseline launcher sets 2048 sequence length, learned positional embeddings and shared decoder input/output embeddings; its settings corroborate the checkpoint implementation.

sources.title: MoE++: Accelerating Mixture-of-Experts Methods with Zero-Computation Experts, Table 4
sources.publisher: Peng Jin et al. / MoE++ team (Skywork AI and collaborators), ICLR 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Table 4 (PDF page 8) explicitly reports OPT-1.3B as 1.3B activated / 1.3B total, citing Zhang et al. (2022), the original OPT paper. It separates this baseline from the pruned Sheared-LLaMA variants. This establishes the MoE++ research team's nominal benchmark convention, not a Meta active-count specification or an exact component-level per-token measurement.

name.note: The official weights table names this exact model OPT-1.3B; catalog spacing preserves its identity.

developer.note: Developed and released by Meta AI.

family.note: Open Pre-trained Transformers family; exact configuration model_type is opt.

release_date.note: Meta explicitly released the 1.3B baseline on this date. The May 2 paper submission and May 11 Hub creation are distinct events.

open_weights.note: Official direct checkpoint download is public and its metadata was accessed without authentication. This records weight availability, not unrestricted licensing.

license.note: Custom OPT model license; the exact checkpoint includes the license titled OPT-175B License Agreement. It is not the implementation repository code license.

parameters_b.note: Retain the prior verified exact unique checkpoint count of 1,315,758,080 (1.31575808B), including positional embeddings, biases and affine norms and counting tied token/output embeddings once. The original metadata audit and configuration support this precision. The fresh review reopened the original OPT paper, official downloads table and pinned configuration; the published nominal size remains 1.3B. No weights were downloaded or tensor census repeated in this pass.

active_parameters_b.note: MoE++ Table 4 explicitly assigns the original OPT-1.3B baseline a nominal 1.3B activated count. Attribute this convention to Jin et al. / the Skywork AI research team, not Meta. Keep its published precision alongside the precise total; the source does not establish exact per-token participation or component scope.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer: every block has ordinary attention and a two-matrix ReLU FFN; the full checkpoint and implementation contain no expert routers or expert banks.

context_window.note: Maximum sequence length is 2048 tokens. The learned positional table has 2050 rows because of the two-row offset; it does not imply a 2050-token context.

modalities.note: Text-token causal language model producing text-token continuations; no other modality encoder or decoder.

reasoning.note: Pretrained base completion model with no separate native reasoning mode documented. General benchmark performance or prompted reasoning is not a reasoning-mode flag.

tool_call.note: Base text-completion checkpoint; no native structured tool-call protocol or instruction/chat interface is specified. Downstream wrappers can supply their own protocols.

description.note: Accurately describes the original research model without unsupported performance or capability claims.

patch.notes: OPT-1.3B is the nominal size name; the exact checkpoint has 1,315,758,080 unique parameters, counting tied token/output embeddings once and including positional embeddings, biases and layer norms. The nominal 1.3B active count follows Jin et al. / Skywork AI's MoE++ Table 4 benchmark convention; it is not a Meta specification or exact per-token tensor count. This is a pretrained text-completion checkpoint with no documented native reasoning mode or tool-call protocol. The May 3, 2022 public release predates its May 11 Hugging Face repository creation. Weights use the custom OPT noncommercial research license.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retained the verified exact 1.31575808B total after reopening Meta's original paper, weights table and pinned configuration. Replaced the undisclosed active count with nominal 1.3B from Jin et al. / Skywork AI's original MoE++ Table 4 comparison of the exact OPT-1.3B baseline. This is a published benchmark convention, not an exact per-token count. The other 12 field assessments are unchanged.
